subject: Pioneer Diagnostics: execution canvas & sprint owners
messages:
From: Sara Klein <sara.klein@pioneerdx.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps - MAP and milestones

Thanks Logan — the product team here liked the demo. We need a clear, timeboxed plan from kickoff to pilot. Can you share a high-level mutual action plan with milestones, OKRs, and who owns each item? We are aiming for a Nov 1 pilot start. Key constraints: SOC 2 evidence must be provided before sandbox access and we need an SSO integration scheduled.

Audience: Project leads (Sara, Rajiv), IT (Devops lead), Redwood CS.

Ask: Please send a one-page timeline and point owners by end of week.

—Sara
Product Lead, Pioneer Diagnostics

(attachment: current infra diagram referenced in-demo.pdf)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sara Klein <sara.klein@pioneerdx.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Pioneer Diagnostics - execution canvas + proposed owners

Hi Sara — thanks for the quick note and glad the demo landed. Attached is a draft execution canvas (PioneerDX_Execution_Canvas_v1.xlsx) and a short MAP summary (see PDF attached) that maps milestones to owners and target dates. High level items below: 

- Kickoff meeting (orient + tech alignment) — owner: Logan Wright (Redwood CS), target: 2026-09-24
- SOC 2 evidence delivery (customer -> Redwood) — owner: Sara Klein (Pioneer Dx), target: 2026-09-29 (must be in place before sandbox access)
- Sandbox provisioning & initial model access — owner: Ben Carter (Redwood Infra), target: 2026-10-03
- SSO integration (SAML) — owner: Pioneer IT (Rajiv will lead), Redwood support: Monica Patel, target window: 2026-10-04 to 2026-10-08
- Integration test plan & smoke run — owner: Monica Patel (Redwood CS), target: 2026-10-15
- Pilot go/no-go review — joint owners: Pioneer Product + Redwood CS, target: 2026-11-01

Notes and asks: 
- I attached two files (canvas spreadsheet + condensed MAP PDF). Please confirm owners and the SOC 2 timing; if that shifts we will rebase the sandbox date.
- Proposed kickoff: Fri Sep 24, 11am PT (I can send an invite once we lock).

Attachments: PioneerDX_Execution_Canvas_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), PioneerDX_MAP_v1.pdf (PDF)

If that looks reasonable I will convert the canvas into a weekly sprint roster and share a calendar cadence.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

(attachment stubs included above)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Klein <sara.klein@pioneerdx.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pioneer Diagnostics - execution canvas + proposed owners

Internal note and alignment — looping Ben for infra timing. Logan — I can own the integration test plan and the smoke run. I will draft the first two-week sprint tasks after Friday's kickoff. Ben, can you confirm GPU sandbox availability the first week of Oct and whether we need any additional procurement approvals?

Quick priorities from CS perspective:
- Draft test cases (Monica) — due 2026-10-01
- Bridge/alerts & runbook (Monica + Ben) — due 2026-10-10
- Data handling checklist for pilot (Logan lead for redlines) — due 2026-10-08

I will prepare a one-page RACI and share in the channel. Sara — if you can confirm the SOC evidence list (certifications + evidence bundle) by EOD 2026-09-17 that would keep the schedule intact.

Thanks — Monica
Customer Success Director, Redwood Inference

(On internal items: attachment PioneerDX_Execution_Canvas_v1.xlsx — v1 with owners populated)

From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@pioneerdx.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pioneer Diagnostics - execution canvas + proposed owners

Thanks Logan and team. This looks good — two quick asks from my side before kickoff: 
1) Please add a procurement milestone: SOW signed + PO in our system (we need the DocuSign link for the SOW). Target for that to be completed by 2026-09-30.
2) Our IdP team has limited bandwidth; SSO work will need the Oct 4–8 window (as noted). Please make sandbox access conditional on SOC evidence + signed SOW.

Confirming new kickoff date: Sep 24 is tight for our legal team. Can we move kickoff to Sep 24 at 2pm PT or Sep 27 AM? If you prefer Sep 24 we will try to attend for the tech alignment only.

Best,
Rajiv Menon
CTO, Pioneer Diagnostics

(attachment: internal procurement checklist.xlsx referenced)

Logan Wright
